g.text: import + triage (< 1 s, 26 s at 44 M faces)

g.title: side
g.text: fast: side fitting the time budget)

g.title: fail
g.text: Any step that fails or overruns its share of the time:
keep the stage before it, warn, carry on.
Extreme input: the import stage is the output ("fully unoptimized").

g.title: budgets
g.text: • 1 M faces (eCorpus's simplify ratio targets 1 M vertices)
• 128 MB of GPU textures, 4096 per side
• fast: about 10 s for the whole run
